_registration_note: Written and committed before the first A12 simulation. Field ids verified live (GET /data-fields/{id}, no simulation) the same day; see evidence/worldquant_brain_a12_v1/field_verification.json. Human-readable version: docs/BRAIN_A12_PREREGISTRATION_V1.md.
_submission_note: Simulations only. Nothing is submitted to BRAIN for checks or to the consultant program. Submission acts on the owner's account and is the owner's decision.

settings._why_market_ladder: Matches worldquant_brain_search_v1, where the full-coverage cap control measured +0.091 / middle-8 -0.119. A MARKET-neutral decile alpha is that decile's return in excess of the rest of the scored universe, so the ladder carries no market beta.

budget.no_substitution: If a hypothesis dies on field resolution, parse failure or density, that is recorded as its result and no replacement hypothesis is run.
budget.parse_failure_rule: One syntax-only correction is permitted per expression (same fields, same sign, same horizon); it is recorded. A second failure ends that variant.

H1_revision_breadth.channel: analyst estimate revisions (queue A5; never measured in this project)
H1_revision_breadth.sign: positive: more upward than downward revisions ranks high
H1_revision_breadth.field_interpretation_risk: BRAIN describes these only as 'number of upper/lower estimations' and 'number of forecasts counted'. Interpreted as the vendor's (believed FactSet) consensus up/down revision counts for the annual period. The counting window is not documented. If 'upper' instead means estimates above consensus, this becomes an estimate-skew measure with no stated prior. Recorded before running, not after.

H3_iv_skew.sign: negative: a steeper smirk (OTM-put IV above OTM-call IV) ranks LOW
H3_iv_skew.field_interpretation: BRAIN: mean IV at 90% strikes minus mean IV at 110% strikes. Higher = steeper downside smirk. Taken from the description; the numeric convention cannot be checked without a simulation and is not checked.

H4_call_put_iv_spread.channel: options-implied put-call parity deviation / implied borrow cost (Cremers & Weinbaum 2010; Bali & Hovakimian 2009)
H4_call_put_iv_spread.sign: positive: call IV above put IV ranks high

H5_recommendation_change.channel: sell-side recommendation changes (Jegadeesh, Kim, Krische & Lee 2004; queue P2's ConsRecomm)
H5_recommendation_change.sign: positive: consensus moving toward buy ranks high

controls._why: Step 317: a control must MATCH THE CANDIDATE'S COVERAGE. group_rank(assets, sector) at coverage 0.5 ordered +0.867; group_rank(cap, sector) at coverage 1.0 was flat at +0.091. Each control ranks market cap within sector on exactly the NaN mask of its hypothesis's first variant, so it scores the same names. Verified after the run by comparing scored-name counts (long+short), not assumed.

density_guard.reading: longCount = names with a non-zero, non-NaN signal; shortCount = names at exactly zero. Density = longCount / 3000 (share of the TOP3000 universe with a usable non-zero value), also reported as longCount / (longCount + shortCount).
density_guard.bar: density >= 0.50 of the universe, else UNREADABLE and no ladder is run for that variant
density_guard.applies_to: variants whose construction can produce exact zeros (H1, H5). The level variants (H2, H3, H4) are continuous; BRAIN field coverage 0.67 to 0.97 already clears the floor, and their ladders carry the tie check below.
density_guard.tie_check_every_ladder: each decile's longCount must lie between 5% and 15% of that decile alpha's (longCount + shortCount); otherwise the ladder is UNREADABLE (ties) and is not scored

reading.evidence: decile monotonicity (full ladder AND middle eight), top-minus-bottom spread (d10 - d1), against the coverage-matched control
reading.not_evidence: BRAIN Sharpe, fitness, turnover, returns of the production form. Reported, never used to decide.
reading.verdict_strings: run_worldquant_brain_decile_ladder_v1.verdict(): ORDERS ITS DECILES / CONCENTRATION / flat / INVERTED / DEGENERATE
lead_requires_all_of: verdict ORDERS ITS DECILES (full > 0.5 and middle-8 > 0.5, same direction, positive in the declared sign)
full > its control's full AND middle-8 > its control's middle-8
joint permutation p (P[full >= obs and middle-8 >= obs] over random orderings of the ten decile returns, 200,000 draws) below Bonferroni 0.05 / cumulative trials
full-ladder monotonicity > 0 in at least 4 of the 5 calendar years (yearly-stats recordset, no extra simulations)
if all the above hold: one de-sized ladder, group_rank(<inner signal>, bucket(rank(cap), buckets=5)), must still read > 0.5 full ladder
reading.sign_discipline: The sign is inside every expression and never changes. INVERTED is a refutation, not a discovery with the sign flipped (guardrail 2).

multiple_testing.bonferroni_denominator_conservative: 302 + 15 = 317 (every prior simulation counted as a trial)
multiple_testing.fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.05 over the 15 A12 permutation p-values, reported alongside
multiple_testing.platform_caveat: BRAIN's shared in-sample window has been searched by thousands of users; that search is uncountable and makes any pass weaker evidence than the same pass on our own data.

reading.window: In-sample on the platform (expected 2019-01-01 to 2023-12-31, read off the first alpha record). The hypotheses were chosen from literature published 2002-2010 on pre-2006 samples and were never measured by this project, so the window is post-publication for every one of them; it is NOT an untouched window.
